TRAITS.name: Root-Road
TRAITS.text: As a bonus action, choose two spaces of natural ground within 20 feet. Until the start of the next turn, a visible root seam joins them. Snarlroot can treat the seam as normal ground even across roots, brush, or a low obstacle, and it can move along the seam without provoking opportunity attacks.

TRAITS.name: Deep-Footed
TRAITS.text: While touching natural ground, Snarlroot has advantage on saves against being knocked prone or moved against its will.

ACTIONS.name: Rootclub Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Rootclub attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Rootclub
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning.

ACTIONS.name: Turn the Root (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Choose one creature on natural ground within 20 ft. It makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, roots carry it up to 15 ft. along the ground to an unoccupied space and it cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, it can be moved up to 5 ft. only.

TRAITS.name: Name the Threshold
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: choose a 15-ft. line of natural ground within 15 ft. Until the start of the Warden’s next turn, the line is visibly braced by roots and bent branches. The Warden can use Bar the Way when a hostile creature crosses that line.

TRAITS.name: Bark-Ribbed
TRAITS.text: The first time each round the Warden takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce it by 3.

ACTIONS.name: Branch Spear Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Branch Spear attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Branch Spear
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing.

REACTIONS.name: Bar the Way
REACTIONS.text: When a hostile creature crosses the named threshold, move up to 10 ft. without provoking. If the Warden ends within reach, the creature makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. On a success, its remaining speed is reduced by 10 ft.

TRAITS.name: Leafway
TRAITS.text: When initiative is rolled, choose two living plants or natural growths within 30 ft. Until the end of Larkskein’s first turn, it can spend 5 ft. of movement to move from adjacent to one to adjacent to the other. This is movement through the Wood, not teleportation, and deals no damage.

TRAITS.name: Pollen Map
TRAITS.text: When Larkskein hits a creature, that creature leaves a faint visible trail until the start of Larkskein’s next turn; it cannot benefit from being hidden from Larkskein during that time.

ACTIONS.name: Glass-Thorn
ACTIONS.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 90 ft.; Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing.

ACTIONS.name: Summer Fold (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Choose a 15-ft.-radius area within 60 ft. Until the start of Larkskein’s next turn, creatures treat every 10 ft. moved inside the area as 5 ft. when moving toward the center and 15 ft. when moving away. No creature loses an action or is forcibly moved.

TRAITS.name: First Nails
TRAITS.text: When initiative is rolled, place two visible nail marks in spaces within 20 ft. Quillshrike may then move up to half speed toward one of them. No attack or save occurs.

TRAITS.name: Snap to the Nail
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: choose one nail mark within 30 ft. Move up to 15 ft. in a straight line toward it without provoking opportunity attacks, then remove that mark. This movement scars the ground it crosses until the start of the next turn.

ACTIONS.name: Quillblade Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Quillblade attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Quillblade
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) psychic once per turn.

ACTIONS.name: Black Fan (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 15-ft. cone, DC 16 Dexterity save; 18 (4d8) piercing on a failure, half on a success. The ground in the cone becomes visibly scored by straight black cuts until the end of the next round.

TRAITS.name: Breakroot
TRAITS.text: The first 10 ft. of natural difficult terrain Marrowstalk enters on a turn costs no extra movement. The spaces it crosses become scarred until the start of its next turn; natural difficult terrain in those spaces is suppressed, and a hostile creature entering a scarred space spends 5 extra ft. of movement.

TRAITS.name: Marrow Grip
TRAITS.text: A creature hit by Marrow Hook has its speed reduced by 10 ft. until the start of Marrowstalk’s next turn; multiple hits do not stack.

ACTIONS.name: Marrow Hook Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Marrow Hook attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Marrow Hook
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing.

ACTIONS.name: Body Break (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: One creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. Failure: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning, knocked prone, and moved up to 10 ft. into a space Marrowstalk can see. Success: half damage and not moved.

TRAITS.name: Survey Stake
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: create one crystal stake in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Maximum two stakes; creating a third removes the oldest. A stake is an object (AC 13, 8 HP) and provides no cover.

TRAITS.name: Refracted Origin
TRAITS.text: When making a ranged spell attack, Shardbound can have the attack originate from itself or from one of its stakes it can see. Range is measured from the chosen origin. This can bend a sight line but does not increase damage.

ACTIONS.name: Shard Bolt Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Shard Bolt attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Shard Bolt
ACTIONS.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 100 ft.; Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) force.

ACTIONS.name: Survey Lance (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Draw a 60-ft. line from Shardbound or one visible stake. Creatures in the line make a DC 16 Dexterity save; 22 (5d8) force on failure, half on success.

REACTIONS.name: Break the Survey
REACTIONS.text: When Shardbound is targeted by an attack, it can destroy one visible stake within 30 ft. to impose disadvantage on that attack. Once per round.

TRAITS.name: Spellcasting
TRAITS.text: 7th-level spellcaster; spell save DC 17, +9 to hit. Slots 4 / 3 / 3 / 1. Core control list: Entangle, Web, Hold Person. A spell replaces Multiattack.

ACTIONS.name: Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: The Crone makes two Claw attacks, or casts a spell.

ACTIONS.name: Claw
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

ACTIONS.name: Venomous Eruption (1/Day)
ACTIONS.text: Choose a point within 60 ft.; creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere make a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure: 27 (6d8) poison damage and poisoned until the end of the creature’s next turn. Success: half damage and not poisoned.

ACTIONS.name: Blighted Vitality (Recharge 4–6)
ACTIONS.text: Choose up to two creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, healing received is halved until the end of the Crone’s second turn after the effect begins. Reapplying the effect does not extend or stack the duration.

TRAITS.name: Darkmane (Constant)
TRAITS.text: Darkmare creates one-way magical obscurement around itself. Non-allied creatures are obscured through the effect; Darkmare and its allies see normally.

TRAITS.name: Umbral Passage
TRAITS.text: At the start of Darkmare’s turn, it may move or teleport up to 30 ft. and carry one willing allied creature inside Darkmane with it. Umbral Passage fails while Darkmare’s speed is below 34 ft.; that is the encounter’s pinning threshold.

TRAITS.name: Shadow Shroud (1/Day)
TRAITS.text: Action: choose Darkmare or one creature within 60 ft. The target gains +2 AC until the end of Darkmare’s next turn, and attacks against it have disadvantage until it is hit once. The disadvantage ends on that first hit; the AC duration does not.

ACTIONS.name: Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Darkmare makes one Horn attack and one Hooves attack.

ACTIONS.name: Horn
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) cold damage.

ACTIONS.name: Hooves
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

TRAITS.name: Keep Your Distance
TRAITS.text: Once on each of the Regent’s turns when it hits a creature with a melee attack, it can push that creature up to 5 ft. directly away from itself.

TRAITS.name: Unyielding Bearing
TRAITS.text: The Regent has advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.

ACTIONS.name: Briar Talon Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Briar Talon attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Briar Talon
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing.

ACTIONS.name: Invitation Withdrawn (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Each enemy of the Regent’s choice within 15 ft. makes a DC 16 Strength save. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) slashing damage, is pushed 15 ft. directly away from the Regent, and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. This action replaces the Regent’s Multiattack. DM DESIGN READ

TRAITS.name: Perfect Host
TRAITS.text: The Host has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

TRAITS.name: Even-Handed Hospitality
TRAITS.text: At the start of each of the Host’s turns while neutral, choose exactly one party creature and one creature opposing the party within 60 ft. A creature chosen on the previous Host turn cannot be chosen again. Both gain Courtesy until the start of the Host’s next turn.

TRAITS.name: Courtesy
TRAITS.text: The target’s speed increases by 10 ft. The first 5 ft. it willingly moves while Courtesy lasts does not provoke opportunity attacks.

TRAITS.name: Hospitality Broken
TRAITS.text: If a party creature damages the Host, or the party reduces a Fey allied with the Host to 0 HP, the Host becomes hostile to the party immediately. The death of a Fiend does not trigger this trait.

TRAITS.name: Courtesy Withdrawn
TRAITS.text: While hostile, Even-Handed Hospitality continues to choose one creature from each side. The allied target receives Courtesy. The party target instead receives Discourtesy.

TRAITS.name: Discourtesy
TRAITS.text: The target’s speed is reduced by 10 ft. The first time it willingly moves on its turn, it cannot take reactions until that movement ends.

TRAITS.name: An Unwelcome Guest
TRAITS.text: While hostile, once per turn when the Host damages a creature affected by Discourtesy, it can move that creature up to 5 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Velvet Rebuke Multiattack (Hostile Only)
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Velvet Rebuke attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Velvet Rebuke (Hostile Only)
ACTIONS.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft.; Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic. DM DESIGN READ

TRAITS.name: Braced Form
TRAITS.text: The Bulwark has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to resist being knocked prone or moved against its will.

TRAITS.name: Interposing Bulk
TRAITS.text: A hostile creature moving through the Bulwark’s reach toward a creature on the opposite side of the Bulwark treats that movement as difficult terrain.

ACTIONS.name: Bulwark Fist Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Bulwark Fist attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Bulwark Fist
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning.

REACTIONS.name: Take the Blow
REACTIONS.text: When another creature within 10 ft. of the Bulwark is hit by an attack, the Bulwark can move up to 5 ft. toward that creature without provoking opportunity attacks. If it ends within 5 ft. of that creature, reduce the triggering damage by 8. The Bulwark then takes 4 damage that cannot be reduced or prevented. Once per round. DM DESIGN READ

TRAITS.name: Boughway
TRAITS.text: When the Charger moves at least 15 ft. through natural vegetation, the path it crossed becomes easy ground until the start of its next turn: difficult terrain from plants is suppressed there for every creature.

TRAITS.name: Rooted Turn
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: speed becomes 0 until the start of the next turn; AC increases by 2 and it has advantage on saves against forced movement. It cannot use this after moving more than 10 ft. this turn.

ACTIONS.name: Tusk Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Tusk attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Tusk
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing.

ACTIONS.name: Canopy Rush (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Move up to 30 ft. in a line through natural vegetation. One creature in the path makes a DC 16 Strength save. Failure: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning and pushed up to 15 ft.; success: half damage and no push.

TRAITS.name: Through the Wound
TRAITS.text: Rift-Slick can move through a space as narrow as 3 inches without squeezing. When it passes through natural cover, roots, or a tree-space, it leaves a 5-ft. scar at the exit until the start of its next turn.

TRAITS.name: Scar Slip
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: move up to 15 ft. to a scarred space it can see without provoking opportunity attacks. This is physical movement through a wound in the terrain, not teleportation.

ACTIONS.name: Slick Claw Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Slick Claw attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Slick Claw
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing.

ACTIONS.name: Warping Cut (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 30-ft. line, DC 16 Dexterity save; 18 (4d8) force on failure, half on success. The line becomes scarred ground until the end of the next round.

TRAITS.name: Drive Nail
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: place one nail in an adjacent solid surface. Maximum two. A nail is an object (AC 13, 8 HP). A straight line up to 20 ft. long between Nail Saint and a nail is a claimed line until the start of the next turn.

TRAITS.name: Claimed Line
TRAITS.text: The first hostile creature each round that crosses a claimed line must spend 10 extra ft. of movement or stop immediately before crossing, its choice. Forced movement ignores this rule.

ACTIONS.name: Boundary Spike
ACTIONS.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 90 ft.; Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) force.

ACTIONS.name: Hammer the Border (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Choose one visible nail within 60 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 16 Strength save; 18 (4d8) force on failure and pushed 10 ft. away from the nail, half damage and no push on success.

TRAITS.name: Burn Script
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: mark one solid surface within 30 ft. with a burning sigil until the start of the next turn. Natural vegetation around the sigil blackens but does not ignite.

TRAITS.name: Written Origin
TRAITS.text: Brandwing can originate one ranged spell attack or line effect from itself or from its Burn Script sigil. Range is still measured from the chosen origin.

ACTIONS.name: Brand Ray Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Brand Ray attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Brand Ray
ACTIONS.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 100 ft.; Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) fire plus 3 (1d6) force once per turn.

ACTIONS.name: Scald the Name (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 30-ft. line from Brandwing or its sigil, DC 16 Dexterity save; 22 (5d8) fire/force on failure, half on success. On a failure, the target cannot benefit from half cover until the end of its next turn. CURRENT F8 RETAINED CREATURE — Ashstep remains in the active Occupied Acre roster as the hunter/skirmisher.

TRAITS.name: Spent Stain
TRAITS.text: When a creature within 60 ft. expends a spell slot or a limited-use class or item resource, that creature’s space becomes stained until the start of Ashstep’s next turn. A space can hold only one stain.

TRAITS.name: Ashstep
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: move up to 30 ft. toward a stained space without provoking opportunity attacks. It must use normal terrain and cannot pass through creatures or solid objects.

ACTIONS.name: Rend Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Rend attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Rend
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 4 (1d8) psychic once per turn.

ACTIONS.name: Follow the Spend (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Move up to speed toward a stained space, then make one Rend attack with advantage. The stain is removed whether the attack hits or misses.

TRAITS.name: Broken Gleam
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: Disengage and move up to 10 ft. This movement cannot rise vertically unless it starts from higher ground.

TRAITS.name: Moon-Slick Scales
TRAITS.text: The first opportunity attack made against the wyrmling each round has disadvantage.

ACTIONS.name: Bite
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) radiant.

ACTIONS.name: Moonshard Breath (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 30-ft. line, 5 ft. wide; DC 14 Dexterity save (Charisma-based); 14 (4d6) radiant on failure, half on success.

TRAITS.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
TRAITS.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

TRAITS.name: Broken Lift (Recharge 5–6)
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: launch and glide up to 40 ft., ignoring ground terrain and opportunity attacks. It must end on a surface that supports it; it has no standing fly speed.

TRAITS.name: Moonmark (2/Day)
TRAITS.text: Action: choose a point within 60 ft.; a 15-ft. radius fills with pale motes until the start of the dragon’s next turn. Creatures of the dragon’s choice in the area make a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, they cannot benefit from invisibility and the first attack against them before the effect ends has advantage. No damage.

ACTIONS.name: Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Bite
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) radiant.

ACTIONS.name: Claw
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft.; Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing.

ACTIONS.name: Fractured Dream Breath (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 60-ft. cone, DC 17 Constitution save. Failure: until the end of the target’s next turn, speed is halved, it cannot take reactions, and the first attack against it has advantage. The first time the target takes damage, the no-reactions and advantage portions end immediately, but the speed reduction remains until the normal duration ends.

ACTIONS.name: Moonfall Breath (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 90-ft. line, 10 ft. wide; DC 17 Dexterity save; 36 (8d8) radiant on failure, half on success. The two breath options share the same recharge.

LEGENDARY ACTION.name: Tail Sweep
LEGENDARY ACTION.text: Once per round at the end of another creature’s turn, make one Tail attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft.; Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning, and the dragon may move 5 ft. without provoking from the target hit.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Ground Remembers Wrong
LAIR ACTIONS.text: Choose up to three 10-ft. squares of natural ground within 90 ft. Creatures there make a DC 17 Strength save or slide up to 10 ft. to a safe space chosen by the lair.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Branches Close
LAIR ACTIONS.text: A 15-ft.-radius sphere within 90 ft. becomes heavily obscured by overlapping leaves and wrong-angle branches until the next initiative count 20.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Borrowed Sky
LAIR ACTIONS.text: Choose one creature within 90 ft. The lair moves it up to 20 ft. horizontally and 10 ft. vertically, placing it safely on a surface. An unwilling creature can resist with a DC 17 Strength save.

TRAITS.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
TRAITS.text: If the Harrower fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

TRAITS.name: Residual Hunger
TRAITS.text: Once per round when a creature within 60 ft. expends a spell slot or limited-use class or item resource, Harrower may move up to 10 ft. without provoking. Nothing is stolen or suppressed.

TRAITS.name: Fracture Seed
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: place one visible fracture in an unoccupied space within 40 ft. Maximum two. A fracture occupies no space and provides no cover. It lasts until the Harrower creates a third or is incapacitated.

TRAITS.name: Wrong Origin
TRAITS.text: A Rift Lance may originate from Harrower or from one fracture it can see. Range is measured from the origin. This changes geometry, not damage.

ACTIONS.name: Rift Lance Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Rift Lance attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Rift Lance
ACTIONS.text: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft.; Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) psychic.

ACTIONS.name: Unmake Distance (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: 30-ft. cone from Harrower or a fracture, DC 18 Intelligence save; 27 (6d8) psychic on failure, half on success. A failed creature is also moved up to 15 ft. toward or away from the origin, Harrower’s choice.

REACTIONS.name: Fold Thought
REACTIONS.text: After an attack targeting Harrower resolves, move up to 10 ft. without provoking; once per round.

LEGENDARY ACTION.name: Mind Hook
LEGENDARY ACTION.text: Once per round at the end of another creature’s turn, one creature within 30 ft. of Harrower or a fracture makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. Failure: 7 (2d6) psychic and moved 10 ft. toward the origin; success: no effect.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Adjacent Elsewhere
LAIR ACTIONS.text: Choose two 10-ft. spaces within 90 ft. Until the next initiative count 20, a creature that enters one may spend 5 ft. of movement to exit from the other. Each creature can use this once per turn.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Memory of Falling
LAIR ACTIONS.text: Choose a 15-ft.-radius area within 90 ft. Creatures there make a DC 18 Strength save or slide 10 ft. in one horizontal direction chosen by the Harrower. No damage.

LAIR ACTIONS.name: Wrong Angle
LAIR ACTIONS.text: Choose a 20-ft.-radius area within 90 ft. Until the next initiative count 20, ranged attacks that originate inside or target inside the area treat half cover as no cover and three-quarters cover as half cover. The distortion benefits both sides.

TRAITS.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
TRAITS.text: If the Colossus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

TRAITS.name: Impossible Mass
TRAITS.text: Advantage on saves against being knocked prone or moved against its will.

TRAITS.name: Anchor the Wrong
TRAITS.text: Bonus Action: until the start of the next turn, speed becomes 0, reach increases by 5 ft., and it cannot be moved against its will. It can end this effect early at the start of its turn.

ACTIONS.name: Crushing Multiattack
ACTIONS.text: Makes two Fist attacks.

ACTIONS.name: Fist
ACTIONS.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft.; Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning.

ACTIONS.name: Collapse Space (Recharge 5–6)
ACTIONS.text: Creatures of the Colossus’s choice within 15 ft. make a DC 18 Strength save. Failure: 22 (5d8) force and knocked prone. Success: half damage and not prone.
